independence: No evaluator imports or calls; recomputed directly from original Polar HR notifications and frozen prediction CSVs using integer UTC ns. Official evaluation not yet available at initial independent calculation.

protocol_checks.freeze_alignment_source_review: Source reads ZIP timestamp, video fps/frames and hash metadata, never HR prediction values or HR reference values for offset selection.
protocol_checks.display_precision_note: video_start_utc_estimate string is rounded to microseconds; integer ns is authoritative and equals 07:32:51.166718500 UTC.

official_comparison.evaluator_source_review: Reads HR UTC int64 and subtracts the fixed absolute video origin before float conversion. Uses half-open nominal 10s mean, original reference denominators in own/common, and all fixed shifts without argmin/best-shift selection. Inference sources/configuration and inputs are hashed.
official_comparison.waveform_numeric_scope: All three methods independently recomputed by NumPy rFFT with explicit mean detrend, periodic Hann, density normalization, 8192 FFT, fixed .7-3.5Hz band and reference H1 +/-0.1Hz; no evaluator/scipy import or invocation.

limitations: Metrics are conditional on an unverified mtime-derived alignment; the archived timestamp is only whole-second precision.
Predeclared time-shift sensitivities are not a confidence interval or calibration; do not choose the shift with smallest error.
Device HR notification delay and averaging are undocumented; this is not ECG or verified synchronization.
Overlapping windows from a single new video are not independent subjects; LoA are descriptive only.

waveform_independent_QA.PSD_definition: abs(rFFT((x-mean(x))*hann,8192))^2 /(fs*sum(hann^2)); multiply non-DC/non-Nyquist one-sided bins by 2. A single whole-window Welch segment equals this periodogram.
waveform_independent_QA.reference_origin: Independent 0-shift integer-UTC window means already audited; same reference for all methods.
